title: Demetrius - Players Circle
htmlContent:
Based out of Frederick, Maryland, Demetrius is a hip-hop artist who has a unique capability to combine melodies and rhythms in a way that sounds completely seamless. This is one of the main reasons Demetrius's music is cherished by his ever-loving fans. Demetrius is witnessing the fruits of his endeavor in actual time and is ready for us to see the next branch of his booming career.

Demetrius is back at it again with some new heat, discharging his most unique single, "Players Circle," a track with an empowering delivery; it's easy to see that Demetrius is an artist who loosens his pain through poetry and passionate lyricism. 

Demetrius's "Players Circle" is available on all music streaming outlets.
